_comment: Vegeta's Big Bang, ad (object 1/04, docs/rom.md). Frames and animation by npm run rom -- export --fighter vegeta; this file by hand: 4 / -4 px a frame is b0's vx / vy, kept the whole flight ($0F:BAB6 never changes it), so it flies airborne with no gravity, entered through fires.state so its launch applies. Type and damage are the objects' hit table's ($3D:9624); where it hits it becomes a/02 ($2A:8F0B). Its hit and block sounds are the other projectiles' — not read for it.
